items.text: Cleveland (final report): no one OUT or DOUBTFUL. QUESTIONABLE: CB Myles Harden (hamstring), S Daniel Thomas (ankle). RT Tytus Howard cleared the concussion protocol Saturday and will play; Jared Verse and Elgton Jenkins have no designation.

Pittsburgh (final report): OUT: CB Brandin Echols (hamstring), DB Doneiko Slaughter (hamstring). QUESTIONABLE: WR Ben Skowronek (calf). Jalen Ramsey and Alex Highsmith have no designation; Aaron Rodgers is not on the report.
